title: GridSim v1 transmission.json
description: The lines and cables of the case, one record each. Optional file. Boundaries and tap changers refer to branches by name. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

line.title: Line
line.description: A line or cable (v1 LineDto). r/x/b are per unit on the case base for ONE circuit; 'circuits' identical circuits run in parallel (the loader divides r and x by it and multiplies b and the rating by it). Absent: r/x/b 0, ratingMva 0 (unrated), circuits 1, no dynamics class, lengthKm 0, no equipment, rPu0/xPu0 0.

name.title: Name
name.description: Branch name; boundaries and tap changers find branches by it. Absent: none.

rPu.title: Resistance (pu, one circuit)
rPu.description: Series resistance of one circuit, per unit on the case base. Absent: 0.

xPu.title: Reactance (pu, one circuit)
xPu.description: Series reactance of one circuit, per unit on the case base. Absent: 0.

bPu.title: Charging susceptance (pu, one circuit)
bPu.description: Total shunt charging susceptance of one circuit. Absent: 0.

ratingMva.title: Rating (MVA, one circuit)
ratingMva.description: Thermal rating of one circuit. Absent: 0 = unrated (never reported overloaded).

circuits.title: Circuits
circuits.description: Number of identical parallel circuits. Absent: 1.

dynamicsClass.title: Dynamics class
dynamicsClass.description: Name of a passive-plant asset class in asset-classes.json bound to this line. Absent: none.

lengthKm.title: Length (km)
lengthKm.description: Circuit length, for frequency-dependent line modelling. Absent: 0 (unknown).

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Conductor type for the skin-effect model: ohl (overhead line) or cable. Absent: none.

rPu0.title: Zero-sequence resistance (pu)
rPu0.description: Zero-sequence series resistance of one circuit, per unit on the case base. Absent: 0 (not supplied).

xPu0.title: Zero-sequence reactance (pu)
xPu0.description: Zero-sequence series reactance of one circuit, per unit on the case base. Absent: 0 (not supplied).

tapRatio.title: Off-nominal turns ratio
tapRatio.description: Off-nominal turns ratio of a converted MATPOWER transformer kept in branch order (F24). Absent: 1.

phaseShiftDeg.title: Phase shift (degrees)
phaseShiftDeg.description: Phase shift of the branch (F24). Absent: 0.

isTransformer.title: Is a transformer
isTransformer.description: The branch is a transformer (labels, fault studies) rather than a line (F24). Absent: false.

ratingBMva.title: Short-term rating B (MVA, one circuit)
ratingBMva.description: Short-term rating of one circuit (MATPOWER RATE_B, F20); multiplied by circuits like ratingMva. Used only when a contingency screen is asked to judge post-fault loading against rating B. Absent: 0 (not given; such a check then uses ratingMva).

ratingCMva.title: Emergency rating C (MVA, one circuit)
ratingCMva.description: Emergency rating of one circuit (MATPOWER RATE_C, F20); multiplied by circuits like ratingMva. Used only when a contingency screen is asked to judge post-fault loading against rating C. Absent: 0 (not given; such a check then uses ratingMva).
